correctness.rationale: The cellular Koszul cochain model and natural relabeling action give a direct proof. In 2-label support the only H3 classes arise from nonedges and swap positively; in 3-label support the degree-3-to-4 map has rank 1 and degree-4-to-5 rank equal to the number of induced edges because a triple induces a forest. Signed trace identities reduce the complete characters to fixed triples, edges and vertices, counted for all D_n elements in the proof. An independent exact program verifies 660 group action traces for n=4..18, quotient averages, and all relevant 3-label rank/differential checks for n=4..12. Finite checking is corroborative only.

value.rationale: The first two nonzero cohomology degrees and the dihedral quotient orbit-space Betti numbers are canonical invariants of polygonal complex moment-angle manifolds. Full natural D_n character formulas reveal different reflection-axis contributions in degree three, a reflection sign in degree four, and an order-three correction in the quotient; ordinary Betti numbers do not determine any of these. An infinite family is classified in two lowest positive degrees, including the sharp n=4,5 exception to b4 nonvanishing. This provides useful, nonarbitrary low-degree data for studying finite-symmetry quotients and their cohomology rings without asserting a larger theory.
